summary: Texas Ventures Acquisition III Corp, a blank-check company, issued a $250,000 non-interest-bearing unsecured convertible promissory note to sponsor Yorkville Acquisition Sponsor II, LLC on September 30, 2026. The note matures upon the earlier of an initial business combination or winding up, and is convertible at sponsor election into up to 25,000 private placement units at $10.00 per unit. Principal and conversion consideration are payable in cash by the issuer, with no interest and no premium. The 8-K reports the financing under Items 1.01, 2.03, 3.02, and 9.01, with the note attached as Exhibit 10.1. Watch the SPAC's extension and combination timeline; sponsor conversion would dilute Class A holders at de-SPAC.
